title: When the Agent Becomes the Kernel: A Systematization of Security on the Path to AI-Native Operating Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.23700v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model agents are now privileged principals that take consequential actions: editing code repositories, operating inboxes, completing purchases. Their authority is kernel-grade, but it comes without what classical systems security requires: a trusted mediator interposed on every access. Operating-system vendors are now rebuilding the platform around this de-facto agent kernel, inheriting complete mediation as a design problem. We systematize the security of such systems around a single distinction: a crossing mediated over provenance admits a deterministic check, while one over content semantics does not. A trust-boundary taxonomy locates where mediation must occur and isolates the central mediation gap at two kinds of semantic judgment: distinguishing data from instruction in untrusted input, and an authorized action from an unauthorized one. translated_title: 当智能体成为内核：迈向AI原生操作系统之路的安全体系化研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体现在已成为执行重要操作的特权主体：编辑代码仓库、管理收件箱、完成购买。它们的权限达到了内核级别，但却缺乏经典系统安全所要求的要素：介入每一次访问的可信中介。操作系统厂商目前正在围绕这一事实上的“智能体内核”重建平台，从而将“完全中介”作为一项设计问题继承下来。我们围绕一个单一的区别对这类系统的安全性进行体系化梳理：基于来源的跨界访问可以进行确定性检查，而基于内容语义的跨界访问则不能。我们提出一个信任边界分类法，用于定位中介必须发生的位置，并将核心的中介缺口归结为两类语义判断：在不可信输入中区分数据与指令，以及区分授权操作与未授权操作。我们认为，这一缺口留下了一个不可消除的、无法被检测的攻击残余……
tldr: 该论文系统化梳理了以LLM智能体为“事实内核”的AI原生操作系统的安全问题，指出基于来源的中介检查可确定性验证，而基于内容语义的中介检查（区分数据与指令、授权与未授权操作）存在无法完全消除的缺口，从而导致不可避免的残余攻击风险。
en_tdlr: This paper systematizes security for AI-native operating systems where LLM agents act as de facto kernels, showing that provenance-based mediation admits deterministic checks while semantic mediation (distinguishing data from instructions and authorized from unauthorized actions) leaves an irreducible residual of undetected attacks.
